quality_policy.preferred_publication_level: At least 3 of 6 papers target JCR Q1; every remainder targets at least JCR Q2
quality_policy.note: All papers retain identical doctoral scientific-quality gates. Venue targets require at least three Q1 papers and no paper below Q2; no software can guarantee novelty, peer-review acceptance or doctoral admission.

intake.author_task: Capture only user-confirmed goals, constraints, budget, compute, schedule, application routes, exclusions and ethical boundaries. Leave unknown material facts explicit. Do not approve or advance the gate.

topic-intelligence.hard_floor: Every scored dimension >= 8.0; overall >= 8.5; at least 5 closest primary works; at least 3 traceable databases, adjacent fields and query families; every novelty claim mapped to >=3 closest works with precise difference, falsification and residual risk; backward/forward citation chaining and two consecutive saturation rounds; explicit counterevidence, doctoral synthesis and reliability strategy; automatic broad-data evidence with documented scientific-fit rejections; at least two current JCR Q1 SCI/SCIE candidate venues.
topic-intelligence.author_task: Research at least three serious topic candidates using current primary sources, adjacent literatures, patents where applicable, automatic broad-data discovery, and market/position evidence where relevant. Score candidates against the human-confirmed G0 weights for novelty and doctoral depth, no-laboratory feasibility, funded-position supply, competition, job market and salary, and background fit. Write schema-bound evidence/search-log.jsonl, program/originality-audit.json and program/novelty-claim-matrix.json so every claimed database, query family, closest work and novelty boundary is traceable. For every novelty claim state what is already known, the precise difference, mechanism, falsification test, expected result if false, boundary conditions and residual risk. Preserve citation-chaining and saturation evidence, counterevidence, non-novel elements, rejected topics and datasets, unresolved data-fit risks and uncertainty, and make the core thesis A plus independent extension B form a defensible doctoral knowledge contribution. Do not claim novelty from absence alone or data fitness from metadata alone.

paper-architecture.hard_floor: Every paper must have a unique falsifiable claim, independently sufficient primary evidence, standalone scientific value, a structured originality boundary, at least two current venues meeting its declared JCR Q1/Q2 target, and a high-level experiment strategy; at least three of six papers must target Q1 and every remainder must target at least Q2; every paper pair must pass the anti-salami distinctness matrix; the portfolio must synthesize into one doctoral contribution.
paper-architecture.author_task: Build program/paper-map.json schema 2.0 and a paper-contract schema 2.0 for every configured paper. Assign at least three of six papers target_jcr_quartile=Q1 and every remainder target_jcr_quartile=Q1 or Q2; never lower scientific, originality, reliability or writing gates for Q2-targeted papers. Compare every paper pair, require different research questions and primary claims, independently sufficient evidence and standalone value, explain any shared primary outcome, state shared assets and merge triggers, and show cumulative doctoral progression. Write structured research artifacts in English and reject salami slicing.

experiment-design.hard_floor: Every selected dataset needs a current deterministic hash-bound quality report plus a separate named-human confirmation bound to the report hash; every paper needs executable statsmodels or simulation power evidence and a human-confirmed hash-frozen preregistration before any experiment; every design must pre-plan domain-standard and strong-recent baseline reproduction plus disjoint original/clean-room run IDs in digest-pinned, network-disabled containers with metric tolerances; every paper also needs traceable simple baselines, fair tuning/evaluation, ablations, leakage controls, primary metrics, estimands, practical thresholds, effect sizes and intervals, multiplicity, >=3 seeds for stochastic work, robustness, negative controls, external validity, stopping and falsification rules; every planned run must belong to exactly one design; automatic broad-data evidence must be scientifically screened with rejected alternatives and unresolved risks preserved.
experiment-design.author_task: Use the automatic per-paper broad-data evidence to screen topical/task fit, provenance, sample and unit adequacy, labels, missingness, bias, leakage, external validity, version, compute and no-laboratory feasibility. Preserve rejected datasets, reasons and alternatives. Then produce human-confirmed licensed dataset manifests, one or more schema-bound experiment designs per paper, a machine-executable global plan and a hard budget. Define the inputs for deterministic local data-quality reports and executable power calculations, then have the human generate each report, read its warnings, create the separate named confirmation and freeze every preregistration. Pre-register confirmatory hypotheses, estimands, practical significance, units of analysis, splits, preprocessing fit scope, traceable baseline sources and versions, comparable tuning budgets, ablations, primary and secondary metrics, uncertainty, statistical tests/models, effect sizes, confidence intervals, multiplicity, seeds, external validation, negative controls, robustness, stopping rules and negative-result handling. Include explicit domain-standard/strong-recent baseline run mappings and disjoint original/clean-room runs using digest-pinned, network-disabled containers, a second-operator plan, environment capture and numeric metric tolerances. Never fabricate protected local reports or confirmations, confirm a license for the human or infer scientific fitness from metadata alone.

experiment-execution.hard_floor: Every scored dimension >= 8.0; overall >= 8.5; every paper must reproduce both a domain-standard and a strong-recent baseline within a predeclared tolerance and complete a disjoint-run reproduction in a digest-pinned, network-disabled isolated container; all reports must match the G3-frozen run roles, source URLs and tolerances, reference exact successful registry attempt IDs and their complete current output sets, then receive a protected hash-bound named-human confirmation; observed evidence must support calibrated claims, robustness, external validity and statistics expected by a strong JCR Q1 review. Failed and negative runs remain visible.
experiment-execution.author_task: Execute only the exact G3-approved plan through scripts/experiment_runner.py. Preserve failed attempts, immutable configuration, output hashes and negative results. Build the claim-evidence matrix and reproducibility report without selecting favorable runs. For every paper, build baseline-reproduction.json and clean-room-reproduction.json only from exact successful registered attempt IDs and their complete current hashed outputs; use the frozen domain-standard/strong-recent run mappings, baseline sources, disjoint original/reproduction run IDs, executor-issued container isolation receipts and unchanged numeric tolerances. Do not create reproduction-confirmation.json: the local control plane creates it only after named human review. Never mark a failed comparison as passing.

writing-and-review.hard_floor: Every scored dimension >= 8.0; overall >= 8.5; selected venue must meet the paper's declared current JCR Q1/Q2 SCI/SCIE target with IF >1.0 and the six-paper portfolio must retain at least three Q1 targets; manuscript body must pass deterministic English-language and authentic academic-style validation; the style audit must match the current manuscript hash and must not use detector scores or detector-evasion tactics; two adversarial review rounds have no unresolved fatal findings.
writing-and-review.author_task: Work only on state.active_paper. Write the complete manuscript body, abstract, captions, tables, supplement, responses and cover material in direct, evidence-led English from the claim-evidence matrix. Render publication figures locally from recorded data through the deterministic specification-driven renderer, retaining vector outputs, uncertainty, accessibility and provenance. Remove stock framing, mechanical transitions, repeated sentence openings, vague importance claims and accidental repetition while preserving supported meaning, numbers, equations, citations and uncertainty. The control plane runs scripts/academic_style.py after each writing pass; resolve its concrete findings. Run deterministic English-language, citation and venue compliance checks; preserve two review rounds and itemized responses; complete disclosures. Never optimize against an AI detector, conceal assistance, weaken an AI-use disclosure, invent citations, results, authorship or venue status, or submit.
